title: An input-derived clause-width budget for satisfying weak backdoors
claims: SmallWeakBackdoorWidthBudgetSATInP computes the index length from the original CNF, then consumes exactly that many index bits and a truth bit at every branch.
ConstantWeakBackdoorTightSATInP gives an arbitrary-width corollary with the polynomial budget (4 * (input length + 1))^k for fixed k.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against the exact pinned definitions.
